description: Fill in public/lib.js exactly per its JSDoc (exact output strings). Write public/index.html, public/style.css and public/app.js: load Leaflet 1.9.4 from unpkg (pinned, with integrity), fetch /api/config, show OSM tiles with visible OpenStreetMap attribution, load cameras from /api/cameras on moveend when zoom >= minCameraZoom (circle markers, one placeholder color for Flock and one for other ALPRs, popup with manufacturer/operator), click cycle for start/end via nextClickState, buffer slider within config limits, Plan route button posting buildRouteRequest to /api/route, draw fastest (gray dashed) and avoiding (solid) routes, highlight hit cameras, results panel from summarizePlan, error messages from {error}, a note that coverage is incomplete, and 'Not affiliated with Flock Safety'.
